changelog: Aura AI v2.1.5 — Voice Call Daemon Sync, Gallery Frosted Buttons, Image Indexing & Scroll Polish
Voice Call Lifecycle Sync: Fixed EOFException loop by ensuring conversation registration on hub language server before voice connection
Voice Reconnect Logic: Move retry reset to confirmed listening state so diagnostics surface properly on failures instead of looping
Gallery Frosted White Controls: Removed black circular backgrounds from image action buttons in favor of clean frosted glassmorphism
Comprehensive Image Indexing: Added in-memory RAM cache and deep filesystem scanning (depth 6) so all generated images appear in gallery
Chat Scroll Smoothness: Eliminated image skeleton height recalculations and layout jitter during feed scrolling
